none_percentage.rationale: No drawdown reduction at green macro risk; full exposure maintained (intentional zero)

none_max_exposure.rationale: 100% exposure allowed when no macro risk detected

light_percentage.rationale: 15% reduction for yellow macro risk level (elevated but manageable)

light_max_exposure.rationale: 85% max exposure for light drawdown; allows most positions intact

moderate_percentage.rationale: 35% reduction for orange macro risk (significant outflow concerns)

moderate_max_exposure.rationale: 65% max exposure for moderate drawdown; significant position trimming

severe_percentage.rationale: 60% reduction for red macro risk (crisis-level threat)

severe_max_exposure.rationale: 40% max exposure for severe drawdown; only conviction positions survive

emergency_percentage.rationale: 90% reduction for emergency drawdown; near-total liquidation

emergency_max_exposure.rationale: 10% max exposure for emergency drawdown; minimum viable positions only

orange_override_min_score.rationale: Minimum structural trend override score needed to withstand orange macro risk
orange_override_min_score.todo: Calibrate: test [0.50, 0.65] range against historical orange-regime drawdown outcomes

red_override_min_score.rationale: Minimum structural trend override score needed to withstand red macro risk
red_override_min_score.todo: Calibrate: test [0.70, 0.85] range against historical red-regime drawdown outcomes

sector_constraints_risk_off.rationale: Risk-off flow: reduce growth/risk assets, rotate to defensive
sector_constraints_risk_off.todo: Calibrate: derive multipliers from risk-off regime sector return analysis

sector_constraints_carry_trade_unwind.rationale: Carry trade unwind: exit equities, minimal tech/financials, maximum cash
